sections.heading: Profile
sections.text: Engineering leader who runs the team and still ships the hard parts. Across 12 years at Stripe, Datadog, and two startups, I have built and led the platforms that move when the business needs them to. Today I lead the nine-engineer team behind a real-time payments-risk platform that scores every transaction for tens of millions of merchants, and I still own the parts of the system that fail loudest. An MBA and a habit of writing keep me fluent in the business case, not only the architecture. Whether the room is a design review, a board update, or a 3 a.m. incident, I lead it.
sections.target: Targeting a Senior Engineering Manager role in AI/ML.

entries.title: Principal Engineer, Risk Platform
entries.subline: Remote / Austin, TX · Lead a nine-engineer team across three time zones; report to the VP of Engineering
bullets: Lead the architecture and delivery of the real-time risk platform that scores every transaction for tens of millions of merchants, holding sub-50ms p99 latency at peak.
Drove the platform from nightly batch scoring to streaming inference, re-architecting feature computation onto a Flink and Kafka stack and cutting fraud-decision latency from hours to milliseconds.
Designed the feature store and model-serving layer now shared across four product teams, setting the contracts and SLAs the rest of the org builds against.

Raised the engineering bar through design-review and on-call standards that cut production incidents 45% and lifted deploy frequency threefold; I mentor engineers to promotion and run hiring for the team.
